## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:删除 `@object-ui/collaboration` 里的 `createPresenceUpdater` 和 `@object-ui/mobile` 里的 `requestBackgroundSync` 两个函数体,共 50 行。
- 为什么改:上一个 PR 已把这两个名字移出包入口,仓库内再无任何读取者,留着只是死代码。
- 风险与回滚:无公开面变化,两个包都只有一个 `.` 入口,外部无法导入;回滚即 revert 这一个提交。
- 先看:`ui/packages/collaboration/src/usePresence.ts` 末尾、`ui/packages/mobile/src/serviceWorkerSource.ts` 末尾(都是文件尾部整段删除)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -nw -e createPresenceUpdater -e requestBackgroundSync -- . ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` 只应命中 `.changeset/` 里 #25921 的三个 changeset(本 PR 新增的一个,加上 PR #28385 的两个),源码零命中。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Deletes the module-local function `createPresenceUpdater` (`usePresence.ts`) and `requestBackgroundSync` (`serviceWorkerSource.ts`). No imports or types became unused; no test exercised either function (none found by `git grep -w`). Net 50 deletions plus one patch changeset.

Changeset vs `skip-changeset`: both packages compile with `tsc` and ship `dist` (`files[]`), so `dist/usePresence.js` and `dist/serviceWorkerSource.js` change bytes; a patch changeset is added and no `skip-changeset` label. It is not a public-surface change: the single `.` export of each package already dropped both names.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/collaboration run type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/collaboration/` 7 files / 83 tests pass.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/mobile run type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/mobile/` 6 files / 50 tests pass.
- Dependency closure built first (`@object-ui/collaboration^...`, `@object-ui/mobile^...`).

## Acceptance notes

- Premise re-measured on origin/main 125ad062: `git grep -nw` over the whole tree (examples, packages/console, skills, content/docs, READMEs) finds each name only at its definition plus CHANGELOG history.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exits 1 on one test (`unit-registry-absence-collision`) because `@objectstack/client` has no built entry in this worktree (not built; outside the two packages' closure); it reads `packages/app-shell/...`, not the files touched here. Reported as NOT MEASURED for that family; CI builds it.
